author: Stahly
description:
The Sons of Behemat range has grown once more: Alongside the new battletome and the Brawlers of Behemoth box, this release brings a genuinely massive haul: a single box that builds 3 complete Gargants, plus a brand new character model in Ma Maegran and her pair of Ancient Ghyrochs. In this review, we dig into both kits, walk through every single build option, and show you high-res sprue images so you can see exactly what you're getting.

The post Ma Maegrin, Boss-stomper & Rock-hurler Gargants review: bigger, but also better? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Ma Maegrin, Boss-stomper & Rock-hurler Gargants review: bigger, but also better?
